verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only indirect many-item capabilities. The MCP server and AI Chat can search and analyze patterns across multiple meetings, the notetaker can auto-join all meetings, and transcripts can be exported automatically to S3 and Airtable. A public API and webhooks could support scripted bulk work. None of this is a documented bulk operation that acts on many selected items at once. Missing for 10: documented bulk actions (bulk edit, delete, move, tag, share or export of selected meetings), API batch endpoints, and hands-on corroboration.
